timeline.event: checkout service config_v42 deployed with EU tax endpoint mapping change
first tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors
rollback started: checkout config reverted to config_v41

root_cause: EU tax endpoint misrouting due to faulty checkout configuration change
why_it_happened: A configuration change at 09:14 switched EU tax endpoint mapping incorrectly
The misconfigured endpoint mapping caused EU tax requests to be routed to US-east region
US-east tax endpoint cannot process EU tax quotes, resulting in region mismatch errors
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (would affect both EU and US checkout traffic)
Database pool exhaustion (presents as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to last known good version (config_v41)
